final: WITH per AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name), across AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall FROM per) SELECT p.media_type_name, p.avg_unit_price, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms / a.overall AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN across a WHERE a.overall IS NOT NULL
